lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Dense array of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in an irregular grid pattern posterior to the fifth gill slit, extending across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a localized grid-like anchor system across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal aspect to dark shadow on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Four prominent, nearly parallel, dark vertical linear lacerations/scars are visible spanning across the gill slit region, exhibiting significant pixel intensity contrast compared to the surrounding dermis.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
